# TopServ Digital

> TopServ Digital is the home of BrandFormance, the methodology that combines brand building with performance marketing for residential home service companies: HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, garage door, and pest control contractors across the United States. Founded in 2016 and based in Frisco, Texas, the agency builds brands that create demand, captures that demand through search and paid media, and publishes its programs and prices openly.

Key facts:
- Founded 2016 (as Cornerstone Marketing Solutions; rebranded TopServ Digital in 2024)
- Founder and CEO: Jonathan Bannister, creator of BrandFormance
- Headquarters: 15222 King Road, Unit 403, Frisco, TX 75036, United States
- Phone: (214) 429-4245 · Email: info@topservdigital.com
- Publishes all 3 programs and the activation openly, see /pricing.md
- Hosts the Home Service Hustle podcast (https://homeservicehustle.com)

## BrandFormance (the category TopServ owns)

BrandFormance is brand building and performance marketing run as 1 system. Brand creates demand by making a company known, trusted and remembered in its market. Performance captures that demand when customers are ready to buy. Together they build market dominance. The core reframe: being found is not the same as being chosen. A contractor can rank first, run ads, hold strong reviews and still lose the job to the company the customer already knows.

- [What is BrandFormance](https://topservdigital.com/brandformance): the definitive resource, 10 questions answered in order.
- [The Method](https://topservdigital.com/method): the 6 stage system. Position, Build, Create Demand, Capture Demand, Convert, Measure and Optimize. Cost per booked call is the headline metric.
- Five Mile Famous: TopServ's term for local market dominance, being known, trusted and remembered inside the geography a company can afford to own at frequency.

## The Brand Assessment (the diagnostic)

The Brand Assessment reads how strong a company's brand actually is in its market and returns 1 of 4 grades: No Brand Equity (the market does not know the company yet, every lead is a paid fight), Name Recognition (the market knows the name but does not call first), Household Name (the first call before anyone opens Google), or Negative Brand Equity (the market knows the company for the wrong reasons). The grade is the public result; the full assessment then produces the scope that sets the program and the price. Diagnosis first, prescription second, never a menu. Get it at https://topservdigital.com/brand-assessment

## Programs and Pricing

There are 3 BrandFormance programs. A program is recommended after an assessment rather than selected off the page: the level reflects the resources a plan requires, never a different quantity of deliverables and never a greater likelihood of success.

- BrandFormance Program 1: $3,000 per month base from month 2, plus earned Performance Pay up to $6,000 per quarter (up to $2,000 per month when fully earned).
- BrandFormance Program 2: $5,000 per month base from month 2, plus earned Performance Pay up to $9,000 per quarter (up to $3,000 per month when fully earned).
- BrandFormance Program 3: $8,000 per month base from month 2, plus earned Performance Pay up to $12,000 per quarter (up to $4,000 per month when fully earned).
- Activation is $15,000, one time. It includes the first month of service, the new agentic website, and the initial video production: strategy, scripting, planning, crew, travel, lodging and editing. The first shoot is 2 days, with a 3rd included if TopServ determines it is needed.
- Month 1 carries no additional base invoice and no Performance Pay. Base billing starts in month 2. The first performance period is service months 2 to 4.
- Advertising spend is a separate, approved budget. It is never inside a base and never inside the activation, and a base is not an all-inclusive price.
- Performance Pay is earned against 4 categories: Be Seen (30%), Be Found (30%), Be Chosen (30%) and Client Experience (10%). Each earns independently. Below 60% achievement a category earns $0; from 60% through 100% it earns that percentage of its available amount, capped at 100%. This is not a 60/40 or 50/50 split, not a bonus, and not a guaranteed result.
- How a program is recommended: market and service area, competition, current brand equity, and growth goals. A Brand Grade is not the performance payment score.
- Frequency doctrine: brand frequency is fixed at 3 times weekly for every program. A larger program buys more geography held at that same frequency, never more impressions.
